description: Cue words a router condition may test (design Decision 12), grouped by the need they signal. A condition may use only cues of a group whose targets it shares. Legal NLI stems quote the provision itself, so legal-provision cues fire there although the input already holds it, and the Vi-SQuAD phrase 'định luật' (a law of physics) also matches 'luật': conditions pair the legal cues with the dataset feature.
match: A cue matches as a whole word or phrase, never inside a longer word, in the question text after NFC normalisation, case folding and whitespace collapsing. The question is the text after 'Câu hỏi:' for reading items and the stem before the first option for multiple-choice items (diagnostic_router.cue_present).
written: 2026-10-27, before any cue-level outcome on wide was computed. Only the wording of the wide questions and the number of questions each cue matches were read; no score was read.

calculation_or_combination.need: The answer has to be computed or put together from several facts given in the input: counts, sums, differences, ratios, averages and durations, or comparisons and extremes across entities. This is the reasoning_gap of the audit taxonomy: the premises are present but combining or calculation fails.

cues.gloss: comparative marker: more, less, higher ... than

legal_provision_outside_input.need: The answer depends on a legal provision that the prompt does not contain, so the model has to recall it or be given it: external_evidence_gap when the input lacks it, parametric_knowledge_gap or parametric_knowledge_error when recall fails.

cues.gloss: provision, regulation ('theo quy định': as the law provides)

excluded.reason: 'first': in these questions mostly an attribute to look up ('vai diễn chính đầu tiên'), not an order to work out
'last': the same as 'đầu tiên' ('vua cuối cùng')
bare superlative particle, also in 'duy nhất' (only), 'thống nhất' (unify), 'nhất định' (certain) and 'thứ nhất' (first); the superlatives are listed one by one instead
also in 'tổng thống' (president), 'tổng hợp' and 'tổng cục'; the compounds are listed instead
also in 'ngoại trừ' (except) and 'trừ điểm' (deduct licence points)
'article', but also in 'điều kiện' (condition) and 'điều gì' (what)
'clause', but also 'khoản tiền' (an amount of money)
